thread:
maria: hey team — first day here! I tried cloning repos but get 'repository not found' / permission denied. Anyone to ping?

devon: welcome 😄 Did you accept the org invite? also need SSO + 2FA enabled for org. Which email did the invite go to?

maria: i think invite landed on maria.personal@gmail.com. my work email is maria@redwood.ai. i accepted there initially — maybe that caused the mismatch?

onboard-bot: Hi Maria! Quick checklist:
• Confirm the invite email matches your work email
• Enable SSO (via GitHub -> Organizations -> Configure SAML)
• Set up 2FA
• Sign the Contributor License Agreement: https://cla.redwood.ai/

maria: thanks — where is the CLA link usually? that URL redirects me to okta sign-in & then 403.

alex: @devon i'll reissue the invite to maria@redwood.ai and add to team infra-read. @maria i'll DM once done.

luca: also make sure your SSH key is uploaded to your GitHub account. if clone fails with permission denied, paste the output.

maria: ok here's the error when running `git clone`:
```
Cloning into 'repo-name'...
remote: Repository not found.
fatal: repository 'git@github.com:redwood/repo-name.git/' not found
```

devon: that looks like either no access or wrong repo path. once we reissue invite i'll check org membership. if invite goes to different email, GitHub links it to that account — you might need to claim or transfer.

alex: invite sent to maria@redwood.ai. check email and accept. if you still see issues, @devon will trigger a force-accept.

maria: saw invite, accepted, enabled SSO, uploaded SSH key. still can't push but can clone now. Thanks!

devon: added you to infra-read & infra-write for the repos you need. should be all set. ping here if anything else. :tada:

maria: all good, I can push and open PRs. thanks everyone! :rocket:
